mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ingest_job( job_uid, report_id, report_title_snapshot, title_search_key, source, institution, publish_date, theme_tags, industry_tags, company_tags, ticker_tags, author_tags, original_filename, file_path, ocr_status, chunk_status, vector_status, ocr_attempt_count, chunk_attempt_count, vector_attempt_count, next_run_at, priority, last_error_code, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{jobUid}, #{reportId}, #{reportTitleSnapshot}, #{titleSearchKey}, #{source}, #{institution}, #{publishDate}, #{themeTags}, #{industryTags}, #{companyTags}, #{tickerTags}, #{authorTags}, #{originalFilename}, #{filePath}, #{ocrStatus}, #{chunkStatus}, #{vectorStatus}, #{ocrAttemptCount}, #{chunkAttemptCount}, #{vectorAttemptCount}, #{nextRunAt}, #{priority}, #{lastErrorCode}, #{lastErrorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
